name: Elsa
source:
Former nun. She is the warden of the prison, and is also involved in rehabilitation. She speaks innocently, and always sports a smile on her face. However, she reveals herself to be a terrifying person capable of crushing a man without so much as even raising her voice. 

"I believe that anyone can be happy if they accept their sin"
